notes.title: Magic Girls Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37315549/12eaa9d27a02718434d4a0025a22171390dbc0a7.png[/img]

Hello people,

I would like to announce that SAKURA STARS will receive a major update (V_1.2) containing some changes to the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37315549/2839fb093d00b52d1c02dd964e459261401cd9c6.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37315549/ce5d57feb5607d7703aece76942ece83ebc77f50.gif[/img]


Corrections:

[list]
[*]Music speed has been corrected
Some version 1.2 songs were slightly accelerated, correcting the timing of the songs.

[*]The scoring system has been improved
Now, defeating a minion will give you 100 points while hitting a Boss shot will give you 10 points. This will encourage people who were just dodging minions to defeat as many of them as possible to increase their score.

[*]The sprites had minor corrections
The color of the lace of the characters' clothes is now the same, this was necessary to add the new clothes of the transformation.
[/list]


Major Updates:

[list]
[*]A new powerUP has been added
Now, when you reach 3000 points, your character will transform into a magical girl, improving your shots by one level and changing your look. This change does not apply to Tanuki, who already has the best shot, speed and life. When you lose a life, your transformation is reversed and you need to reach 3000 points again to transform again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37315549/d691ab5079de5c7c7287c034d178d1697df5b213.png[/img]

[*]A new ENDURE game mode has been added
A new game mode has been added, where the goal is to make the most points on an infinite level. The waves will be chosen randomly and will become more difficult as your score increases.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37315549/8b6706b6e1252d2ae84daeeb92180e2224e7de5c.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37315549/2839fb093d00b52d1c02dd964e459261401cd9c6.gif[/img]

[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282710/Sakura_Stars/


Hope you like it,
